_comment: Hooks for symfony-plugin. PostToolUse: format the changed PHP file with PHP-CS-Fixer. Tries Docker first (service 'php'), falls back to the local vendor binary, swallows errors so it never blocks the user.

hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_FILE"; case "$f" in *.php) docker compose exec -T php vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix "$f" 2>/dev/null || vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix "$f" 2>/dev/null; exit 0;; esac
